sn45.25:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the inferior person and the superior person.
sn45.25:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the inferior person?
sn45.25:1.5: Here someone is of wrong view, wrong intention, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, wrong concentration.
sn45.25:1.6: This is called the inferior person.
sn45.25:2.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the superior person?
sn45.25:2.2: Here someone is of right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right concentration.
sn45.25:2.3: This is called the superior person.”
